title: Cosmic Sorcerer Eclipse
description: A surreal fantasy scene depicts a hooded sorcerer standing on a rocky outcrop between massive swirling ocean waves, holding a glowing red staff that shoots lightning toward a giant black hole sun in a pink cloudy sky. To the left is a massive cosmic sphere containing a purple dragon and galaxies, while a large dragonfly hovers near a giant glowing mushroom house on the right.
